correctness.rationale: The proof uses the full idempotent block-fiber decomposition and H_s(M); the exact term ratio localizes r at (t+o(1))n/log n. Uniform Stirling estimates with the actual M, not tn substituted in leading log terms, yield log H_s(M)=M(log n-loglog n)+tn(log t-1)+o(n). Convexity gives the gamma_m entropy gap. The exact u-to-u+1 identity includes the extra endpoint term; its contribution is exponentially negligible at u=n+o(n), N=mn+o(n). Uniform saddle tails justify expected root size and the increment (m+o(1))/log n. Telescoping proves the window and gap trichotomy. Direct finite enumeration and 30 increment checks pass; finite checks are not relied upon as infinite proof.
